title: Helios Console — Branding & UX
description: Managed configuration for Helios Console branding and user-experience settings. Preference domain MUST be com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.ui — deploy via Jamf Pro > Configuration Profiles > Application & Custom Settings (External Applications / Custom Schema) scoped to ALL managed Macs running Helios. This domain carries NO secrets and no destructive capability; it is safe to scope broadly. Values are FORCED and take effect at the next app relaunch. NOTE: sidebarItems, deviceTabs, and deviceActionLabels are COSMETIC label/icon overrides only — they never grant or gate anything (all gating is role-only in the access domain); authentication is enforced in the sign-in/session views. See docs/ConfigProfileMigration.md for the per-key enforcement-status table.

configurationVersion.title: Configuration Version
configurationVersion.description: Schema/profile version stamp (informational — the loader logs it, nothing else reads it).

userInterface.title: User Interface
userInterface.description: Branding and top-level UI visibility switches.

appTitle.title: App Title
appTitle.description: Primary app title shown in branding surfaces.

appSubtitle.title: App Subtitle
appSubtitle.description: Secondary title shown under the app title.

supportURL.title: Support URL
supportURL.description: Help/support link surfaced in the app (e.g. on the login screen). Leave empty to hide. e.g. https://support.yourcompany.com

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Organization name used in branding surfaces. Leave empty for none.

logoURL.title: Logo URL
logoURL.description: HTTPS URL to a custom organization logo image. Leave empty to use the built-in branding.

accentColor.title: Accent Color (hex)
accentColor.description: Accent color as a 6-digit hex value, e.g. #007AFF.

defaultColorScheme.title: Default Color Scheme
defaultColorScheme.description: Preferred appearance for the app. 'system' follows the macOS appearance.

showAnnouncements.title: Show Announcements
showAnnouncements.description: Show the Announcements area in the app.

showSettings.title: Show Settings
showSettings.description: Show the Settings area in the app.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: Marketing tagline under the wordmark on the welcome screen. Empty = built-in copy.

footerText.title: Footer Text
footerText.description: Footer/copyright line on the Settings About card. Empty = composed from the product name and current year.

documentationURL.title: Documentation URL
documentationURL.description: Destination for the About card's Documentation link and the welcome screen's Learn More button. Empty = those affordances are hidden.

feedbackURL.title: Feedback URL
feedbackURL.description: Destination for the About card's Report an Issue link. Empty = the row is hidden.

sidebarItems.title: Sidebar Item Overrides (optional)
sidebarItems.description: Optional per-row LABEL and ICON overrides for the sidebar — COSMETIC ONLY. A row appears because the signed-in user's role grants its module (access roles[].modules), and its order is that module's array position there; this list never controls presence or order. Pick a known row id from the dropdown and set displayName and/or icon; leave a field blank to keep the app's built-in. An id absent from this list uses the built-in label and icon; unknown ids are skipped. (`title` is still accepted as an alias for `displayName` so existing profiles keep their labels.)

id.title: Row ID
id.description: Which sidebar row this override applies to. Pick a known route id.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Label to show for this row. Blank = the app's built-in label.

icon.title: Icon (SF Symbol)
icon.description: Free-form SF Symbol name for this row (e.g. gearshape). Blank = the app's built-in icon.

deviceTabs.title: Devices-Tab Label Overrides (optional)
deviceTabs.description: Optional per-tab LABEL renames for the tabs inside the Devices module. RENAME ONLY — Devices tabs carry no icon override. COSMETIC ONLY: a tab appears because the signed-in user's role grants it (access domain roles[].deviceTabs); this list only relabels one already granted. Pick a known tab id from the dropdown and set displayName; an id absent from this list keeps the tab's built-in title.

id.title: Tab ID
id.description: Which Devices tab this rename applies to.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Label to show for this tab. Blank = the tab's built-in title.

deviceActionLabels.title: Device-Action Label Overrides (optional)
deviceActionLabels.description: Optional per-action LABEL and ICON overrides for the device Actions menu. COSMETIC ONLY: an action's AVAILABILITY is gated ROLE-ONLY by the access domain (roles[].computerActions / roles[].mobileDeviceActions) — this list only relabels/re-icons an action a role already grants and never makes one appear. Pick a known action id from the dropdown and set displayName and/or icon; leave a field blank to keep the built-in. Confirmation-dialog safety copy is app-built-in and is NEVER overridable here.

id.title: Action ID
id.description: Which device action this override applies to.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Menu label to show for this action. Blank = the action's built-in label.

icon.title: Icon (SF Symbol)
icon.description: Free-form SF Symbol name for this action (e.g. bolt.fill). Blank = the action's built-in icon.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Sign-in behavior preferences. ENFORCED in the sign-in and session views — requireBiometric, allowBiometricSetup, sessionTimeout, and allowRememberMe are all acted on by the app; see docs/ConfigProfileMigration.md.

requireBiometric.title: Require Biometric
requireBiometric.description: Require Touch ID / biometric authentication to use the app.

allowBiometricSetup.title: Allow Biometric Setup
allowBiometricSetup.description: Allow users to enable biometric unlock in-app.

sessionTimeout.title: Session Timeout (min, 0 = none)
sessionTimeout.description: Idle session timeout in minutes. 0 disables the timeout.

allowRememberMe.title: Allow Remember Me
allowRememberMe.description: Allow the sign-in screen to remember the last operator.
